scores.why: Evidence: every prep change is a straight port of a validated probe recipe (P1 g, P3 flat-field, mask computed on the un-destriped octv exactly as P1 validated; oct150 from destriped octv with verified affine equivalence). Root causes: agarose, stripes and polarity are addressed; the 'WM/GM is a poor brainstem representation' cause is only half-addressed because the fine loss keeps the [WM,GM] class channels at weight 1,1 next to the intensity channel at w=2 (vascular_refine pattern). Design error verified against refine.py: Refiner.refine clamps ls/sh ABSOLUTELY (ls.clamp_(-0.15,0.15)) and regularises reg*(|ls|^2+|sh|^2) toward isotropy, so with --fine on, I46's depth stretch ln(1.219)=0.198 is clipped to 0.15 on the first step and the gate (structural NCC drop <0.02) cannot catch it because structural NCC is nearly insensitive to depth scale (HANDOFF: 0.021 over +-22.5%); the R8 criterion (stretch within +-0.03) is unpassable as designed. Ignores the P1 (3-5 mm deep-end gap) vs P2 (<1 mm) contradiction and has no intensity-independent check to adjudicate it; a 3 mm move cap alone. Label-free acceptance: yes (restarts, LORO, MI profiles, visual). Regression: lowest of the three - defaults reproduce v1 bit-for-bit, no common.py edit, no DANDI re-prep; R5 destripe ablation is the only isolated measurement of destripe's effect on the pose in any design.

Best data-driven gates (vessel section-phase modulation 2.54 vs 1.23 control -> auto skip; vascular acceptance vessel-NCC>=0.05 separates I46 0.296 from I58 0.0055; init-transform; verdict flags incl. clamp_bound_hit for the I38 case; smoke prep from the 40 um cache, feasible since prep accepts .npy). Relative clamps are correct. But several changes have no probe evidence: switching the slab normalisation to axis 2 with window 45 on I58 (P3 measured the axis-0 version harmless and only suggested the move) changes the input to both the destripe estimate and the P1-validated mask; the --destripe auto threshold r>=0.08 was never measured on a cortex volume ('expected <0.05' is an assumption) yet fires by default; --fine auto is ON for cortex by default. 'Zero-diff on DANDI by construction' is false: window 3xperiod (99 vs 100 on I46), median_stride 3 and a 0.5-2.0 scale clamp alter oct150 on every subject, so regression relies on re-prep plus tolerance tables, and the stated remedy for a failed bound is to raise --fine-min-contrast until it passes (tuning to the test). Keep-components>=5% deviates from P1's largest-CC recipe without validation. Acceptance is label-free and precision_mm is a clean paper number, but its guard/gate thresholds (frac_neg>=0.65 with measured 25/37=0.676 on flattened images) sit one block from the measured value. Scope: 4 owners, ~10 new files, a common.py edit and ~5.5 h serial GPU exceed the budget; highest regression surface.

Best synthesis of the probes: the thesis (signal lives at 1.3-6 mm scale so 0.15 mm is the natural floor; do not sum low-contrast channels; MIND/NGF/|grad| rejected on P2 numbers; vessel channel rejected on P3 numbers; non-rigid diagnostic-only on I46 evidence) is correct and every prep change matches P1/P3 exactly (mask on original octv, destripe axis argmin with 0.8 ratio). FineRefiner(Refiner) with D about identity and loss_of(D)=super().loss_of(T_start@D) is verified correct against refine.py (refine() only calls self.loss_of), giving relative clamps and a stay-near-start prior without touching refine.py - the fix the minimal design lacks. Strongest label-free verification: V6 boundary agreement (OCT rim -> MRI tissue EDT per face class, deep end reported separately) is the only intensity-independent check in any design and directly adjudicates the P1/P2 contradiction; R0 fine-only on the old prep/old pose is the earliest go/no-go; G4 calibrates the label-free U against I46's labelled oracle residual. Regression: low (defaults reproduce v1, no DANDI re-prep, md5 check, baseline rebuilt on current code per HANDOFF trap 22). Flaws: F6 requires MI parabolic peak offsets <=0.5 deg on all axes, which P2 contradicts (MI rx offset -3.1 deg; rotations undetermined at +-3 deg by every measure) and it sits in the licence set, so the sub-mm sentence would be denied for a mis-set threshold; no destripe-isolated ablation on the pose; V7 recovery on resampled MRI is near-tautological; C and D deliberately duplicate the flatten/mask construction so the verifier may check a slightly different image than the optimiser used; largest code surface (verify.py) for a fourth owner.

best_ideas_to_graft:
1. (accuracy -> any winner) FineRefiner(Refiner) parametrised as D about identity with loss_of(D) = super().loss_of(T_start @ D), tissue weight sampled through T and detached: relative ls/sh clamps and a stay-near-start prior for free; verified against refine.py (refine() calls only self.loss_of; clamps are absolute on the optimised params). Mandatory - the minimal design's fine stage regresses I46's 1.219 stretch without it.
2. (accuracy) V6 boundary agreement: boundary voxels of the 0.15 mm OCT specimen mask (minus box faces/invalid, mapped inside the MRI FOV) -> EDT of the MRI tissue boundary, median/p75/p90 per face class with the rim-less deep-end face reported separately, plus the reverse direction. Only intensity-independent check on offer and the arbiter of the P1 (3-5 mm deep-end gap) vs P2 (<1 mm) contradiction.
3. (accuracy) R0 = fine-only run on the OLD prep from the OLD pose via --init-transform, before any re-prep, as the go/no-go for the whole P2 hypothesis; and G4 = calibrate the label-free uncertainty U on I46 against the labelled oracle residual (U must cover it) before quoting U for I58.
4. (robust) Vessel section-phase modulation diagnostic in prep (fold per-plane vessel density at the detected period; I58 2.54 vs off-period control 1.23) as an automatic --vascular skip, plus a vascular acceptance gate (vessel-channel NCC >= 0.05, structural-channel drop <= 0.03, move <= 3 mm) replacing today's unconditional acceptance at register.py:201; both are cheap and evidence-backed (I46 0.296 vs I58 0.0055).
5. (robust) Smoke prep from the cached 40 um octv.npy with --oct-spacing-um 40,40,40 (prep_subject.py already loads .npy; k150 4 vs 8 give identical block means) to iterate mask/destripe/register in ~20 min instead of ~1 h; and the CPU check of the fine implementation against P2's cached arrays (S_ncc at T = 0.1295 +- 0.005, 26/37 blocks negative) before any GPU run.
6. (robust) verdict.py pure-function flags, at least mri_mask_suspect (mri.valley_ratio null), oct_mask_overinclusive (V_o > 1.5 V_m with intensity mask), clamp_bound_hit (|ls| >= 0.95 clamp, the I38 0.861 case), search_margin_thin; one column in summarize.py.
7. (minimal) R5 destripe ablation via a symlinked work dir swapping oct150.npy for oct150_nodestripe.npy (register.py never loads octv) - the only isolated measurement of destripe's effect on the pose; and minimal's discipline that the destripe-off / mask-intensity path stays byte-identical to v1 (keep lines 129-133 order).
8. (shared fix, none of the three) add +-3/+-6 % log-scale sweeps along the three OCT axes to the final unimodality/landscape check - the fine stage optimises affine but every design checks only 6 rigid axes, and P2 never swept scale, which is the likeliest carrier of P1's deep-end discrepancy; lower the polarity-guard fraction to 0.60 or evaluate it on raw intensities (P2: 26/37 raw vs 25/37 flattened; 0.65 is one block from the measured value).
fatal_flaws:
MINIMAL: (a) The fine stage reuses Refiner.refine with ls/sh clamp 0.15 and reg 2.0; refine.py applies these ABSOLUTELY (ls.clamp_(-ls_clamp, ls_clamp); reg*(ls^2+sh^2)), so with --fine on the I46 depth stretch ln(1.219)=0.198 is clipped to 0.15 immediately and pulled toward 1.0; the acceptance gate (structural NCC drop < 0.02) cannot detect it because structural NCC moves only 0.021 over a +-22.5 % depth-scale sweep (HANDOFF). R8's 'stretch within +-0.03' is unpassable by construction. Not a shipping blocker (default off) but the fine stage is wrong for cortex as designed. (b) The fine loss keeps the [WM,GM] class channels at half the weight (chan_w 1,1,2) - the representation the brief names as a root cause for the brainstem - diluting the one sharp measure P2 found. (c) No treatment of the P1-vs-P2 residual contradiction and no intensity-independent check; a 3 mm move cap is the only guard. 
ROBUST: (a) 'Regression within noise by construction' does not hold: default-path changes to oct_slab_normalize (window 3xperiod = 99 vs 100 on I46, stride-3 medians, 0.5-2.0 scale clamp) alter oct150 on every DANDI subject; --destripe auto may fire on cortex with a threshold (r >= 0.08) never measured on any cortex volume; --fine auto is on for cortex; the documented remedy for a failed 0.5 mm bound is to raise --fine-min-contrast until it passes. (b) Switching the I58 slab normalisation to axis 2 (window 45) is unvalidated by any probe (P3 measured the axis-0 version harmless and only suggested the move) and it changes the input to both the destripe estimate and the P1-validated texture mask (P1 validated on the original octv; here the mask sees re-normalised + destriped data, covered only by a 5 %/Dice 0.95 check). (c) Scope: four owners, ~10 new modules, a common.py edit, ~5.5 h serial GPU on a one-job box - the highest probability of not converging in the time available. 
ACCURACY: (a) F6 requires MI parabolic peak offsets <= 0.25 mm / <= 0.5 deg on all six axes and is part of the licence set for the sub-mm sentence, but P2 measured MI's rx offset at -3.1 deg (intensity measures +2.5) with flat rotation profiles and states rotations are undetermined at +-3 deg by every measure; the sentence would be denied for a mis-calibrated threshold - restrict F6 to translations (<= 0.5 mm) and report rotation offsets. (b) No isolated destripe ablation on the registration (R0 vs R2 confounds mask + destripe + new coarse search). (c) V7 recovery on a resampled MRI box measures optimiser precision on near-identical images and will always pass; do not count it as accuracy evidence. (d) C and D deliberately duplicate the flatten/mask construction, so the verification suite may evaluate a slightly different image than the optimiser used; share the FineLevel construction or assert equality of the two F_oct arrays. 
SHARED by all three: polarity-guard fraction 0.65 is one block above the measured 25/37 = 0.676 on flattened images (one boundary block flips the level to 'skipped'); no log-scale sweep in the landscape check although the stage optimises affine and P2 never swept scale; m_spec is derived from T itself (P2 caveat 3) and no design re-derives it from the texture mask or V6 after convergence; the 13.3 cm3 MRI target is uncertain (MRI covers 73 % of the OCT box) so every mask band is a guess bounded only by P1's 1.355.
